title: JPEG shader
body:
No, your internet isn't bad. Disorder of the Stone comes with a built-in JPEG shader that emulates how old Minecraft YouTube videos looked.

![image: JPEG shader](media/1416915511077376030.png)
![image: JPEG shader](media/1416915511559852075.png)

The amount of compression is completely up to you. Be warned, though: the shader doesn't perform well on lower-end devices. It is not a requirement, just a bonus feature for players whose computers can run it, and it won't be enabled by default.
